# Xactly

> Xactly provides intelligent revenue performance management software, specializing in incentive compensation management (ICM), sales planning, forecasting, and AI-powered analytics for enterprise sales organizations.

Xactly serves enterprise clients globally with offices in San Jose, Denver, Canada, Europe, and India. The platform (including Xactly Incent) helps companies manage sales compensation, quota planning, and revenue forecasting using AI/ML technology, while the company maintains its foundational C.A.R.E. values (Commitment, Accountability, Respect, Excellence).
